title: Improving Decryption Quality of IE
summary: IE provides compression-tolerant image encryption, but whether its decryption quality can be improved beyond the current level remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the compression-tolerant image-encryption construction abbreviated IE, further improvement of decryption quality remains unresolved: determine whether its decryption quality can be improved beyond the currently achieved level.

scope.domain: Compression-tolerant image encryption, focusing on the IE construction and its decryption quality.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether IE's decryption quality can be improved beyond the currently achieved level.

citations.label: Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images

progress.summary: The source presents this as one of several research problems opened by the construction and directly asks whether IE's decryption quality can be further improved.
citation_labels: Alexandra Boldyreva et al., Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images
